name: Kuta
description: A palisaded enclosure of sharpened timber and bamboo stakes with a gate. On the alarm the Mandirigma rally here before marching to the landing, and the families nearby take refuge inside. Best built near the Bahay ng Datu and the houses.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
